# DTCG 2025.10 JSON Schemas (vendored)

The official JSON Schemas for the [Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10](https://www.designtokens.org/tr/2025.10/format/),
copied unmodified from [design-tokens/community-group](https://github.com/design-tokens/community-group)
`schemas/src/2025.10/` at commit `882ebd6716abef9a46d8ef5fb12e82009d6cee2e`.

`pnpm verify:dtcg` (`scripts/verify-dtcg.ts`) validates `../../src/tokens.json` against `format.json` here.
Kept in the repo so the check runs offline and against a fixed version of the standard — to move to a newer
version, copy that version's folder in beside this one and point the script at it.
